## Description

Applies Graph Attention Networks over asset relational graphs to compute optimal asset weights directly on the Riemannian manifold of Symmetric Positive Definite covariance matrices.

## Where it may fit

High-dimensional portfolio optimization, multi-asset tactical allocation, risk-parity allocation.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Systematic Multi-Asset Desks.

## Required data

Rolling asset return covariance matrices, fundamental factor panels, relational adjacency graphs.

## Caveats

Combines graph attention mechanisms with non-Euclidean Riemannian manifold logarithmic/exponential maps.
